name: services/prgroups/primary_groups
description: Get information on multiple primary groups.
brief_description: Get information on multiple primary groups.

arguments.name: user_id
arguments.description: ID of a user whose group contents should be returned. This argument may be used only by users with proper administrative privileges.

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section of primary_group method.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: A dictionary mapping primary group IDs to dictionaries describing the groups (as returned by primary_group method). If specified group could not be found, null is returned instead of a dictionary.
errors: • object_not_found - user could not be found; param_name is equal to user_id.
